title: Baked Cheese Blintzes
description: A hearty and indulgent Ukrainian dish featuring cheese-filled blintzes baked to perfection.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine cottage cheese, ricotta cheese, and eggs. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, mix flour and milk to make blintz dough.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add a small amount of melted butter.
Pour a small amount of blintz dough into the pan and tilt to coat evenly.
Add a spoonful of the cheese mixture onto the center of the dough.
Fold the dough over the cheese mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Transfer the blintzes to a baking dish and top with shredded cheddar cheese and a sprinkle of sugar (if using).
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the blintzes are golden brown.
